_doc: Registry of external question sources evaluated for Sentinel-Quiz (see docs/question-sources.md).
status: approved (explicit license compatible with reuse, or written permission recorded in 'permission') |
permission_required (no usable license: needs the author's written permission) |
blocked (content copied from commercial material or exam dumps; never imported).
Only 'approved' sources can be imported (python -m scripts.question_sources import <id>).
review_stats are aggregate numbers of the SME/AI content review of 2026-09-29 (no content is stored here).

sources.name: MichalisKampouridis/security-plus-study
sources.reason: No license (no LICENSE file, no license field; GitHub API license=null): all rights reserved. Best quality of the evaluated sources (sample: 96% correct, realism 4.2), so it is worth asking the author for written permission.
evidence: https://github.com/MichalisKampouridis/security-plus-study (no LICENSE file at the pinned commit)

sources.name: iakhator/comptia-security-plus-701
sources.reason: No license file (MIT is only mentioned in the README, without a LICENSE file or copyright line; GitHub API license=null), so reuse needs the author's written permission. Sample: 92% correct; 89 empty answer keys in finalExam.json were inferred from the explanations and 11 could not be inferred.
evidence: https://github.com/iakhator/comptia-security-plus-701 (README 'License' section only; no LICENSE file at the pinned commit)
src/data/finalExam.json: 100 items with an empty answer key (89 inferred, 11 not inferable)

review_stats.scope: random sample (random.Random(42)); 10 items drawn from the inferred answer keys

sources.name: CostaJr007/security-plus-practice
sources.reason: The repository is MIT-licensed, but its content was copied from commercial ExamsDigest material: 'ExamsDigest Corp' appears in 7 question stems and PDF page numbers up to 1331 are embedded in the text. The repository author cannot license content they do not own.
evidence: LICENSE (MIT, (c) 2026 CostaJr007) at the pinned commit
questions_db_final.json: 'ExamsDigest Corp' in 7 stems; embedded PDF page numbers (1044-1331)
'Correct Answer: X. ... Option A is incorrect.' layout of commercial practice-test books

sources.name: PSYBEAST-GIT/ceh-v13-exam-simulator-2.0
sources.reason: Question stems are verbatim ExamTopics CEH v11 dumps (EC-Council exam content covered by the candidate NDA); the MIT license of the simulator cannot cover them.
evidence: LICENSE (MIT, (c) 2026 PSYBEAST) at the pinned commit
index.html 'var POOL=' question pool: stems match ExamTopics CEH v11 (312-50v11) dump pages verbatim (web search screening, 2026-09-28)

sources.name: TheRrpatil/ceh-v13-exam-mcq135
sources.reason: No license, content only available as a PDF, and low quality (trivia-style items unlike the exam: realism 1.7 on a 25-item sample). Not worth a permission request.
evidence: https://github.com/TheRrpatil/ceh-v13-exam-mcq135 (no LICENSE file at the pinned commit)
'ceh exam mcq135.pdf': 135 questions parsed from the PDF text

sources.name: siriusbkid-commits/gideon-pbq-generator
sources.reason: No license; the repository ships SC300_Exam_BrainDump.pdf (an exam dump) and it is not a question bank: it generates IAM/IoT scenarios with a local LLM, not Security+ PBQs. The Sentinel-Quiz PBQs were written from scratch instead.
evidence: https://github.com/siriusbkid-commits/gideon-pbq-generator (no LICENSE file at the pinned commit)
crew.py / iot_questions_*.py: LLM-generated IAM and IoT scenarios
